definitions.D: Total_Decision_Time, entire callback cumulative SDK time including state acquisition; not inference-only.
definitions.C: Total_Score includes modeled IO time and miss penalty plus D; not subprocess wall time.
definitions.case_sample: Arithmetic-average each metric over repeats, then one D/C share per case. C=0 has no share and is counted separately.
definitions.case_share: Equal-case mean/P50/P90/worst of 100*mean_repeat(D)/mean_repeat(C), restricted to C>0.
definitions.quantiles: P50 ordinary median; P90 nearest rank ceil(.9*n). These are per-case shares, not callback latency quantiles.
definitions.no_io_no_miss: Every repeat reports IO==0 and Miss==0; printed rounding is retained, not asserted exact physical zero.
definitions.point_sensitivity: 10/paired Naive mean C is the slope magnitude of the unclipped 0..10 formula, before saturation/zero conventions; not an achievable savings estimate.
definitions.interpretation: A tiny global raw D share can coexist with D-dominated small cases and normalization sensitivity. Different binary layouts/timing batches must remain separately identified.
